rule: Every host in config/edge-host-registry.v1.json names one profile of each kind. Caddy owns only broad edge limits; Kong owns API rate and per-route size policy.

tls.public-acme: Caddy-managed ACME certificate, TLS 1.2 and 1.3 only (Caddy defaults), HSTS max-age=31536000; includeSubDomains, port 80 redirects to HTTPS
tls.private-mtls: operator-provisioned server certificate on the private ingress address, client certificate required
tls.internal-ca: Caddy internal CA for *.staging.internal names, never installed into a trust store

security_headers.api: security_headers snippet only: HSTS, nosniff, frame DENY, referrer and permissions policy, no CSP
security_headers.web_app: security_headers snippet; the site may tighten frame and permissions policy
security_headers.auth_ui: security_headers snippet in front of Keycloak, which sets its own CSP
security_headers.observability_ui: security_headers snippet; the UI sets its own CSP
security_headers.private: security_headers snippet on private mTLS ingress

logging.json-redacted: JSON access log per host under CADDY_LOG_DIR, rolled at 20MiB, 5 files, 720h; Authorization, cookies, API keys, tokens and secret query values deleted; no bodies
